title.narrative: Strengthening the health system through PBF in Amhara Region

description.narrative: Improved availability and accessibility of good quality healthcare at primary level in the North Achefer, North Gojjam Zone (Amhara Region, Ethiopia), and a stronger health system at large, which supports the progressive realization of Universal Health Coverage (SDG 3.8) in this geographical area.

In May 2015, Cordaid introduced PBF in the Ethiopian health sector, in the arid and pastoralist Borana zone of the Oromia Region, Ethiopia. The implementation of Phase-I from May 2015 to June 2018 and Phase II from July 2018 onwards in the Borana Zone has shown positive results and contributed to an increment in both the utilization and the quality of healthcare services. As a result of the positive effect, The Embassy of the Netherlands (EKN) in Ethiopia granted funding to scale up to other non-pastoralist areas of the Oromia Region, Jimma zone in April 2019, and Phase III in the Borana zone. From July 2021, the project covers 100% of the HFs in Jimma and Borana. After getting encouraging results from both the Jimma and Borana projects, the scale-up of the project was made to the Amhara region in North Achefer of North Gojjam zone, for a period of 17 months, from November 01, 2021, to March 31, 2023. After this, the project was extended up to September 30, 2023. This new 3-year project is a continuation of the previous Health System Strengthening through PBF project.
The project will directly and indirectly benefit a total of 271,635 population residing in around the 9 Health Facilities in North Achefer Woreda.
